title: 1972 — Elizabeth Street Transformed
description: On 17 February 1972, 76mm of rain fell on central Melbourne in a single hour, turning Elizabeth Street — built over the long-buried Williams Creek — into a torrent up to 1.5m deep. The flood stranded commuters, damaged cars, and caused hundreds of thousands of dollars in damage.

title: 7NEWS Flashback: 1972 Flooding
description: Historic footage of the 1972 Elizabeth Street flood, reported by 7NEWS Melbourne.
